name: Mochizuki Ruri
source:
"[i]You want a girl? Grow up, and then we'll talk.[/i]"

She is the homeroom teacher of the protagonist's class and the advisor of the Astronomy Club.
She is a laid-back, trouble-averse teacher who will nap any chance she gets.
She was once known as a child prodigy with extraordinary talents.
Her friendly, approachable nature makes her popular with students.

Position: Hinamori Academy Astronomy Club Advisor
Height: 164cm
Birthday: October 3rd
Likes: Naps, period dramas
Dislikes: Waking up early
